prompt: Camera completely still on the whole cabinet. The slack prongs hang open from the claw head while the white house with the red roof drops away, tumbling once and landing on the heap of coloured houses. It bounces, knocks two small houses aside and settles on its side; coins scatter across the pile. Above, the empty claw sways loosely on its coiled cable, then slowly comes to rest. The cabinet's yellow control panel and doors stay unchanged. Sound: plastic clattering onto plastic, a spill of coins, the faint whine of the idle motor and arcade room tone.
